title: BUGFIX — telegram-bot: duplicate cmdSprintNext import causes TS2300 error
rationale: scripts/telegram-bot.ts imports cmdSprintNext from both cmd-system.ts (Sprint 1276) and cmd-management.ts (Sprint 1056). TypeScript TS2300: Duplicate identifier 'cmdSprintNext'. Additionally, /sprint-next is handled in two separate switch blocks (line 251 and 303). Fix: remove cmdSprintNext from the cmd-system import (cmd-management has the older, more complete version). Remove duplicate case at line 303. Keep cmd-management version.

tasks.description: In scripts/telegram-bot.ts: 1) Remove 'cmdSprintNext' from the cmd-system import on line 23. 2) Remove duplicate 'case /sprint-next' entry at line 303 (keep line 251 which uses cmd-management's version).
